title: Audit Vergrim's Vexation
description: Audit Vergrim's Vexation — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect the folowing things from enemy's in Vergrim's Vexation

  • VV-1A (Mutant Papers)
  • VV-2A (Fade Papers)
  • VV-3A (Whisker Papers
  • VV-4A (Orok Papers)


Quest Reward: 3750 Gold + 1 Kings Coins

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect Papers from the creatures in Vergrim's Vexation and Return to the Townston Lieutenant in Townston.

Offer:

We are on the clock for the Audit on Vergrim's Vexation so we really need you to step up to the plate on this one. Vergerim's Vexation is a pretty nasty dungeon so if I were you, I wouldn't even go. Just resign now and save yourself the constant grind of killing monsters, getting cool loot, and all that nonsense.

You are still here? Fine. Go and collect the papers from the creatures in Vergrim's Vexation and return to me, the Townston Lieutenant, here in Townston when you have the first set. And take it easy this time, you are going to pull something at the pace you're going.

Turn-in:

Ok, hand the papers over. They look good, it seems like they are in order. Here is some coin and I will let you know when you are ready for the next round.

Objectives:

  • VV-1A (Mutant Papers) ×1
  • VV-2A (Fade Papers) ×1
  • VV-3A (Whisker Papers) ×1
  • VV-4A (Orok Papers) ×1

Client level range: 15–30
